scouting.summary: Patient. Waits for you to lead, makes you miss and fires back. Rarely starts the exchange himself.
strengths: High fight IQ: hard to fool
weaknesses: Waits on you: if you don't lead, he barely does, and he can lose close rounds
scouting.tell: When you miss, a counter right hand comes straight back.
scouting.how_to_beat: Feint to draw his counter, don't lead with wild shots, and take him down: he won't come to you.
